summary: Integrate Edge Manager with AAP by stopping flightctl.target and editing /etc/flightctl/service-config.yaml: global.baseDomain plus auth.type aap, insecureSkipTlsVerify false, and aap.apiUrl, externalApiUrl, oAuthApplicationClientId and/or oAuthToken.
questions: How do I configure Edge Manager to use AAP authentication?
Example service-config.yaml for Red Hat Edge Manager
Where do I put the AAP API URL for Edge Manager?

answer_card.title: Edge Manager service-config.yaml for AAP
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
sudo systemctl stop flightctl.target
sudo vi /etc/flightctl/service-config.yaml
```
```yaml
global:
  baseDomain: <edge-manager-ip-or-domain>
  auth:
    type: aap
    insecureSkipTlsVerify: false
    aap:
      apiUrl: https://your-aap-instance.example.com
      externalApiUrl: https://your-aap-instance.example.com
      oAuthApplicationClientId: <client-id>   # manual method
      oAuthToken: <oauth-token>               # automatic method
```
```bash
sudo systemctl start flightctl.target
```
